name: pbl6-asset-maintenance
description: PBL6 SaaS Asset Maintenance and Field Technician Platform

scripts.dev:identity: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter identity-service db:migrate && pnpm --filter identity-service start:dev
scripts.dev:organization: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter organization-service db:migrate && pnpm --filter organization-service start:dev
scripts.dev:asset: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter asset-service db:migrate && pnpm --filter asset-service start:dev
scripts.dev:service-request: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter service-request-service db:migrate && pnpm --filter service-request-service start:dev
scripts.dev:maintenance: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter maintenance-service db:migrate && pnpm --filter maintenance-service start:dev
scripts.dev:workorder: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter workorder-service db:migrate && pnpm --filter workorder-service start:dev
scripts.dev:inventory: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter inventory-service db:migrate && pnpm --filter inventory-service start:dev
scripts.dev:notification: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter notification-service db:migrate && pnpm --filter notification-service start:dev
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm build:packages && pnpm db:migrate && concurrently -k -n identity,organization,asset,inventory,request,maintenance,workorder,notification,gateway "pnpm --filter identity-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter organization-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter asset-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter inventory-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter service-request-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter maintenance-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter workorder-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter notification-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter api-gateway start:dev"
scripts.test:branch-scope: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter api-gateway --filter identity-service --filter organization-service --filter asset-service --filter maintenance-service --filter service-request-service --filter workorder-service --filter inventory-service --filter notification-service build && node scripts/test-branch-service-management.cjs
scripts.test:model-policies: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter identity-service --filter organization-service --filter asset-service --filter maintenance-service --filter workorder-service --filter service-request-service --filter api-gateway build && node scripts/test-model-policies.cjs
scripts.demo:build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter api-gateway --filter identity-service --filter organization-service --filter asset-service --filter service-request-service --filter workorder-service --filter maintenance-service --filter inventory-service --filter notification-service build
scripts.test:demo-seed: pnpm demo:build && node --test scripts/demo/guards.test.cjs && node scripts/demo/test.cjs
